title: Church Order Established
summary: Alma ordains priests and elders to preside over the church in Zarahemla. Repentant nonmembers are baptized and received, while unrepentant, prideful members are rejected and their names blotted out. The church order is established in the city.

explicit_facts.text: Alma ordained priests and elders by laying on his hands to preside and watch over the church.
Repentant people who did not belong to the church were baptized unto repentance and received into it.
Church members who did not repent and humble themselves, including those lifted up in pride, were rejected and their names blotted out.
The order of the church was established in the city of Zarahemla.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Alma lays his hands on the priests and elders as he ordains them.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance and number of the priests, elders, and other people.
The specific baptismal method and setting.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict unmentioned individual reactions or identify any person among the groups.

title: Gathering, Fasting, and Prayer
summary: The word of God is available to all, and the children of God are commanded to gather often, fast, and pray for those who do not know God.

explicit_facts.text: None were deprived of the privilege of assembling to hear the word of God.
The children of God were commanded to gather often and join in fasting and mighty prayer for the welfare of the souls of those who knew not God.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The children of God gather together.
unspecified_visual_details: The specific gathering place, participants, and manner of fasting or prayer.

narration.text: none were deprived of the privilege of assembling themselves together
join in fasting and mighty prayer

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The prayer for people who do not know God is not a depiction of those people as present.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a divine or supernatural figure in response to prayer.

title: Alma Goes to Gideon
summary: After making the regulations, Alma departs from the church in Zarahemla, crosses east of the river Sidon, and goes to the valley of Gideon, where a city has been built and named Gideon.

explicit_facts.text: After making the regulations, Alma departed from the church in Zarahemla and went east of the river Sidon into the valley of Gideon.
A city had been built in the valley and called Gideon, after the man slain by Nehor with the sword.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Alma travels from Zarahemla across the river Sidon toward the valley of Gideon.
unspecified_visual_details: The route, appearance of the river crossing, and architecture of either city.
Gideon and Nehor are mentioned as part of the city's history, not shown as present.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Gideon or Nehor in the present scene.

title: Alma Teaches in Gideon
summary: Alma begins declaring the word of God to the church in the valley of Gideon, bearing testimony of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, who should come to redeem his people from their sins.

explicit_facts.text: Alma began to declare the word of God to the church established in the valley of Gideon.
Alma's message included testimony of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, who should come to redeem his people from their sins.

unspecified_visual_details: The number and identity of people in the church and the appearance of the gathering place.

narration.text: the testimony of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, who should come to redeem his people from their sins

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Jesus Christ as physically present.
